'Wrist vs fingertips' says a public Pose targets the grasp point between the fingertips (stated for LIBERO). On yam_real/yam-isaac I sized the top-down hub grasp as if the TCP were the fingertip line: a TCP 16 mm below the gear-hub top closed on the teeth 22.5 mm below it (jaw width 0.65-0.66 instead of 0.47-0.51 on the hub) and the gear jammed tilted on the shaft, seed 52 in v03. proposed_new.title: Park bimanual YAM arms out of the overhead view before perceiving
proposed_new.trigger: yam_real bimanual station, metric camera 'top': an object near either arm's home pose is partly hidden (fewer parts found than expected, e.g. 2 of 3 shafts). Cost: one move_to_joints per arm (~2-3 s wall, 2 motions of the episode budget), grippers empty. PARK_SWING_RAD 0.7 is the swing used on yam-isaac (arms end near y=+-0.47, z=0.91, clear of the wall).
proposed_new.code:
OUTWARD = {"left": 1.0, "right": -1.0}   # joint-0 sign that swings each YAM arm away from the table centre
PARK_SWING_RAD = 0.7                       # swing used on yam-isaac; arms then sit near y=+-0.47, z=0.91
home_joints = get_robot_state().joint_positions   # read at program start, both arms at home

def park(arm):
    target = [float(v) for v in home_joints[arm]]
    target[0] = target[0] + OUTWARD[arm] * PARK_SWING_RAD
    moved = move_to_joints(target, tolerance=0.02, max_steps=200, arm=arm)
    return bool(moved.ok)

for arm_name in ("left", "right"):
    park(arm_name)
plate = segment_text("top", "gear base plate")   # perceive only after both arms are parked
proposed_new.evidence: yam_real/gear_assembly/task_0 seed 54: v00 failed 'gear base with three shafts not found' (right arm over the plate); with parking, 3 shafts found on all 10 seeds (5 dev + 5 unseen-check)

proposed_new.title: Find raised pins/shafts on a plate and select the middle one
proposed_new.trigger: Goal names one of several identical pins/shafts standing on a plate ('the middle of the three shafts'). Segment the plate with prompt 'gear base plate' (fallback 'blue plate') on camera 'top', project with mask_to_point_cloud(..., target_frame=base_frame), and use surface_z = median z of that cloud (the plate top). min_rise 12 mm / join_r 15 mm suit ~10 mm pins about 30 mm tall spaced at least 4.5 cm apart. Reject a candidate unless exactly 3 clusters share a top height (max-min < 1 cm) at least 15 mm above surface_z, which also rejects the robot mounting plates.
proposed_new.evidence: found the 3 shafts and the correct middle one on all 10 seeds run (dev 51-55, unseen-check 66-70), including rotated plates (53, 54) and uneven spacing (seed 51: 7.6 cm / 4.5 cm)

proposed_new.title: Grasp beyond the top-down envelope: tilted orientation search, then a table relay
proposed_new.trigger: yam_real: solve_ik(backend='mink') of the top-down grasp fails ('best configuration is 0.03-0.16 m from the target') because the object is far from the shoulders, while the place step needs a vertical approach. Search pitch 90->30 deg and yaw 0/+-30 deg with an 8 cm stand-off along the approach axis. Gripper empty while searching. Cost: 2 IK calls per orientation (~0.02 s each, no ticks). If the result is not top-down, set the object down at a relay point that the inserting arm reaches top-down (search a grid around the midpoint of the two arms' home EE positions, at least 8 cm clear of other objects). Then park the arm, re-localize, and re-grasp top-down.
proposed_new.evidence: dev seeds 51, 53, 54, 55 (gear out of top-down reach; picked at pitch 45-75 deg) and unseen-check 67, 68, 69 all passed through the relay; v00 (top-down only) 0/5

proposed_new.title: Top-down grasp of a hubbed gear: hub-top centre, 10 mm deep
proposed_new.trigger: Gear (or any part with a raised hub over a wider flange) lying flat, seen from the metric camera 'top', to be grasped top-down on yam_real. Prompt 'light blue gear' (the flat gear base also answers, so bound the projected extent at both ends). Measured on yam-isaac: hub top is the highest 2% of the cloud, teeth top 22.5 mm lower (radial z-profile from the hub centre). The jaw contacts at least 6.5 mm below the EE point, so a 16 mm depth closed on the teeth. Gripper empty on approach; one move_to_pose per segment (~3.7 s wall).
proposed_new.code:
seg = segment_text("top", "light blue gear")
best = None
for cand in seg.segmentations[:8]:
    cloud = mask_to_point_cloud(cand, "top", target_frame=get_robot_state().base_frame)
    xs = sorted(float(p[0]) for p in cloud.points)
    ys = sorted(float(p[1]) for p in cloud.points)
    if len(xs) < 30:
        continue
    ext_x = xs[int(0.95 * (len(xs) - 1))] - xs[int(0.05 * (len(xs) - 1))]
    ext_y = ys[int(0.95 * (len(ys) - 1))] - ys[int(0.05 * (len(ys) - 1))]
    if 0.015 < ext_x < 0.07 and 0.015 < ext_y < 0.07 and (best is None or cand.score > best[0]):
        best = (float(cand.score), cloud)   # bounded both ends: the 20 cm gear base also answers this prompt
if best is None:
    raise ValueError("gear not found")
zs = sorted(float(p[2]) for p in best[1].points)
hub_top = zs[int(0.98 * (len(zs) - 1))]
top = [p for p in best[1].points if float(p[2]) > hub_top - 0.004]
gear_x = sum(float(p[0]) for p in top) / len(top)    # centre of the hub's top face
gear_y = sum(float(p[1]) for p in top) / len(top)
HUB_GRASP_DEPTH = 0.010   # TCP below the hub top; 0.016 closed on the teeth 22.5 mm below the top
grasp_z = hub_top - HUB_GRASP_DEPTH
proposed_new.evidence: v03 (16 mm): seed 52 failed (jaw width 0.66, gear jammed tilted). v04/v05 (10 mm): 5/5 dev, widths 0.41-0.52
